package.name: salesforce
package.summary: Salesforce Sales Cloud is a leading Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software provided by Salesforce Inc. It enables users to efficiently manage sales and customer relationships through its APIs, robust and secure databases, and analytics services. Sales Cloud provides several API packages to perform operations on sObjects and metadata, execute queries and searches, and listen to change events through API calls using REST, SOAP, and CometD protocols.
